title: Tell verifiers to reuse recorded fmt, clippy and test results
summary: Retry the failed job with a narrower scope. Edit the verifier prompt so verifiers cite Athena's recorded fmt, clippy and test results instead of rerunning the full suite, and run only targeted tests for new behavior. Add a changelog note naming the 2026-10-18 timeouts. Make no code changes.

defaults_applied.how: One prompt file and a changelog line, because the earlier wide attempt hit the deadline.
The criteria check what the verifier is told to do: cite recorded results and run targeted tests.
A cargo test -p athena-context criterion confirms the existing brief tests still pass.
The prompt and changelog text give the reason and the dates.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Goal: stop verifiers rerunning the full test suite, so they stay within the time limit. Audience: Athena's verifiers and the operator reading their verdicts.

The typed request is only 'try again', so I use the original request. The introspection's wider proposal (checkpoints, watchdog, resumable retry) is out of scope here, as its own text also says to do this retry prompt-only.
The first attempt timed out with 7 deliverables, so this retry is narrowed to one prompt file plus the changelog.
briefs.rs has a snapshot test with the exact checks section text, so changing the brief code would need a snapshot update. I leave it alone.

acceptance_criteria.text: crates/athena-context/prompts/verifier.md tells the verifier that the fmt, clippy and test results in the 'Checks Athena ran on this tree' section are recorded for the candidate and must be cited, not rerun, and that the full `cargo test` suite is not to be rerun.

The same prompt says a criterion such as 'cargo test passes' is satisfied by citing the recorded check, and that new behavior is exercised only with targeted commands such as `cargo test -p <crate> <filter>`.
The prompt keeps that a failed or missing recorded check is not a pass (the verifier may then run that one check), so no failure can be counted as passed.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry naming the 2026-10-18 verifier timeouts (full suite ~11 min) as the reason.
The diff touches only the verifier prompt and CHANGELOG.md: no Rust source, no snapshot tests, no watchdog or retry machinery.
Run `cargo test -p athena-context`; it passes, showing the prompt edit did not break the brief snapshot tests.

out_of_scope: Producer checkpointing, early-stop watchdog, timed-out status and resumable `athena retry`
Changes to briefs.rs, verify.rs or the brief snapshot tests
departures: Narrowed scope to a prompt-only edit, so I expect lower cost and a higher pass rate than the reference.
